verdict.rationale: Superpowers ships as a standard skill set through a marketplace (`/plugin marketplace add obra/superpowers-marketplace`, then `/plugin install`), plus Devin CLI plugin install, an Antigravity Marketplace manifest, and git-clone installs for other harnesses. A lead could standardize a team on it this way, and the writing-skills module supports authoring new skills. However, installation is per-user and per-harness, and nothing shows a team-wide rollout path, a private marketplace, or skills committed to a project repo. Missing for 10: a documented team/org distribution workflow, project-committed skill configuration, and a way to publish a team's own custom skills through a shared marketplace or repo.
